routines.name: Morning Research
routines.prompt: Run the morning research routine. Check market status first via python3 scripts/trade.py status. If open, pull bars and news for every symbol in watchlist.json, calculate 20-day and 50-day moving averages, and write findings to today's journal file.

routines.name: Trading Session
routines.prompt: Run trading session. Read today's research. Check positions and cash. Decide buy/sell/hold for each watchlist symbol using the decision framework in CLAUDE.md. Place limit orders within 0.2% of the ask. Record every decision in today's journal.

routines.name: End of Day Journal
routines.prompt: Run end-of-day routine. Pull final positions and account value. Complete today's journal entry with an end-of-day reflection.
